choices.text: Let them talk. People say more to a listener than to a question.
Nod, and keep your own counsel.

nodes.text: Well, it appears that he has given you satisfactory reasons for his landing at Porto-Ferrajo?
Yes, most satisfactory, my dear Danglars.
Fernand’s paleness appeared to have communicated itself to Danglars.

title: Penelon — quay talk: the voyage home
